pages.title: Thornwick Juniors club wiki
pages.body: How the club runs: committee, teams, pitches and the clubhouse.

pages.title: Matchday checklist
pages.body: Nets up, corner flags out, first aid bag, match ball and the referee's fee in an envelope.

pages.title: Clubhouse opening and locking
pages.body: Alarm code from the chair; last out checks the urn is off and the shutters are down.

pages.title: Referee fees
pages.body: Referee fees are paid from the matchday float and logged in the book.

pages.title: Kit washing rota
pages.body: Each family takes the kit bag once a season; the rota is on the noticeboard.

pages.title: Fundraising ideas
pages.body: Quiz night, bag packing at the supermarket, sponsored walk.

pages.title: Weather policy
pages.body: Grass pitches are inspected at 8:00 on matchdays; the 3G is playable unless frozen.

pages.title: Christmas tournament 2026
pages.body: Saturday 19 December, four pitches, mixed teams, mince pies.
